title: Privacy Policy
content:
## Information we collect
We collect your name, email and exam activity to run your account and show your results.

## How we use it
Your data is used only to provide tests, rankings and course access. We never sell it.

## Contact
Write to us from the Contact page for any privacy request.

title: Terms of Service
content:
## Using ExamForge
By creating an account you agree to use the platform for personal exam preparation only.

## Content
All questions, tests and course material are the property of ExamForge and may not be copied or redistributed.

## Accounts
We may suspend accounts that share logins or attempt to tamper with exams.

title: Refund Policy
content:
## Eligibility
Refunds can be requested within 7 days of purchase if you have not attempted more than one test of the purchased series.

## Process
Contact support with your order ID. Approved refunds are returned to the original payment method within 5–7 working days.
